name: Lateral Epicondylalgia / Tennis Elbow
definition: Load-related pain at the lateral elbow, usually involving the common extensor tendon origin, especially extensor carpi radialis brevis.

investigations.MRI: Ultrasound/MRI only when atypical, refractory or surgical planning is required.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs when joint disease or trauma is suspected.

amber: Injection choices require individualized review; repeated corticosteroid may worsen longer-term outcomes.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kurpara-region Snayu/Vata phenotype may be documented as correlation only.

patientEducation.summary: Load-related pain at the lateral elbow, usually involving the common extensor tendon origin, especially extensor carpi radialis brevis.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
